answer: Admission runs through one throttled canyon gate: each new identity posts a refundable bond and gets paid work only from that slot. Rewards require receipts that verifiers independently recompute, plus surviving a comet-style audit — an unpredictable spot check forcing re-execution of a random past task; a miss forfeits the bond. Violet fingerprints bind each key to one passage, so clones cluster in the audit graph and are pruned with sponsors. A sybil farm must stake N bonds, idle them K epochs, pass N audits: linear cost per fake agent against fixed rewards turns profit negative.
